budgets._comment: Phase 8 performance budgets (ROADMAP P8.1.1; docs/qa-and-performance.md section 2). Read by e2e/budgets.mjs. Values are medians over the harness repeats unless named otherwise; ms, kB (1000 bytes, gzip over the wire), MB (2^20 bytes). Reference: the development Mac (Apple M1 Pro), system Google Chrome headless, viewport 1400x820, the vite preview on localhost.
